tips.text: Walk up and hit with Twilight Assault's empowered attacks when you trade. They deal extra damage based on the target's max Health.
Send the Spirit Blade through the enemy with Twilight Assault as you pull it back. Hitting a champion makes them slowed and gives you more Attack Speed.
Aim Shadow Dash so it catches the enemy in the line. They are taunted and must walk at you, so follow up with your empowered attacks.
Hitting an enemy champion with Shadow Dash or Twilight Assault gives Energy back, so use them on champions and not only on minions.
Place Spirit's Refuge where a fight will happen. It blocks enemy basic attacks on you and your allies standing inside it.
Use any ability when you trade, because Ki Barrier gives you a shield. Touching an enemy champion with an ability makes it come back sooner.
Watch your allies' health after level 6. Stand United lets you shield a teammate anywhere on the map and teleport to them after a channel.
Don't use Stand United with enemies able to interrupt you. Stuns and other hard crowd control cancel the channel before you arrive.

combos.name: Dash into Twilight Assault
combos.when: When trading with a taunted enemy in lane.
combos.text: Cast the Q while still dashing. It pulls the blade through the taunted enemy, slows them and empowers your attacks, so you can hit them as soon as you land.

combos.name: Moving the Refuge zone
combos.when: When you want to protect an ally and the blade isn't where the fight is.
combos.text: Place the zone, then recall the blade with Q. The protective zone is dragged along with the blade, so you can reposition it.

tips.text: Dash into the enemy with Shadow Dash to taunt them, then let your carry hit them while they are forced to chase you.
Cast Spirit's Refuge when enemies are about to auto-attack you or your carry. It blocks their basic attacks for a short time.
Use Twilight Assault to pull the blade back through enemies. It leaves them slowed, and your next attacks hit harder.
Hit an enemy champion with Twilight Assault before you attack. That gives you extra Attack Speed and more damage on your next attacks.
Hitting enemies with Twilight Assault or Shadow Dash gives Energy back. Use them on champions to keep trading.
From level 6, watch the map for allies in trouble. Stand United shields them right away, and you teleport to them after the channel.
Casting any spell gives you a shield. Affecting an enemy champion with that spell makes Ki Barrier come back sooner, so look for chances to hit them.
If your Spirit Blade is stopped on its way back, you get no empowered attacks or shield. Don't recall it through anything that could block it.

combos.name: Flash taunt
combos.when: When the enemy is just out of Shadow Dash range and you want to taunt them anyway.
combos.text: Flashing during the dash ends it early, but the end-of-dash check still hits enemies at the Flash location. This adds reach to your taunt.

combos.name: Dash into Spirit Blade
combos.when: When you taunt an enemy and want to hit them with the Spirit Blade and an empowered attack.
combos.text: You can cast Twilight Assault while dashing. Throw it back through the taunted enemy as you dash to slow them and get the empowered attacks.

tips.text: Use Spirit's Refuge when Aatrox walks up to trade; his basic attacks and Deathbringer Stance bonus hit are blocked while you stand in the zone.
Hit Aatrox with Twilight Assault first, then fight him with your empowered attacks; they hit harder and attack faster.
Dash into Aatrox with Shadow Dash when he spends his dash or swings; he is taunted and must fight you.
Step out of the edges of The Darkin Blade; the tips of each swing knock you up and hurt the most.
At level 6, look for ways to use Stand United to join a fight elsewhere when your lane is pushed and Aatrox is stuck.

comboRefs.note: Shadow Dash taunts Aatrox, so you can follow with Twilight Assault and an empowered attack to trade.

tips.text: Walk up and use Shadow Dash on Briar when she is in Blood Frenzy; she can only chase the nearest enemy, so you can lead her into a fight with your team.
Use Spirit's Refuge when Briar is hitting you or an ally in Blood Frenzy; it blocks her basic attacks.
Hit Briar with the Spirit Blade from Twilight Assault so she is slowed when moving away and your next attacks hit harder.
Her Head Rush is a stun; stay out of its range if you can, and trade right after she spends it.
When Briar charges Chilling Scream near a wall, stay out of the line; a full charge knocks back and stuns you.

comboRefs.note: Briar's Blood Frenzy self-taunts her, so Shen's taunt-based Dash into Twilight Assault trade is safer.

tips.text: Stay out of Apprehend range when you can. If Darius pulls you in, you eat his full combo, so keep Shadow Dash ready to take him back.
Fight him when Apprehend is on cooldown. He has no way to pull you in then, so poke him with Twilight Assault and your empowered attacks.
Cast Spirit's Refuge when Darius commits to an attack. It blocks his basic attacks, including Crippling Strike, which cuts down his damage.
Taunt Darius with Shadow Dash while his Decimate is winding up. It stops him from standing and trading freely.
Hit him with Twilight Assault and then attack. The slow and extra attack speed help you win short trades and walk away.
At level 6, use Stand United on a hurt ally to shield them and teleport in. Watch Noxian Guillotine, which can finish weak allies.

comboRefs.note: Taunting Darius with Shadow Dash lets Twilight Assault slow him and your empowered hits land in the trade.

tips.text: Don't land Shadow Dash on Fiora while Riposte is ready; she blocks the taunt and answers with a slow or stun. Bait Riposte out first.
Once Fiora has used Riposte, dash in with Shadow Dash and trade while it recharges.
Cast Spirit's Refuge on yourself when Fiora commits to a fight; it blocks her basic attacks and her Lunge damage.
Use Twilight Assault to hit Fiora, then fight her with the empowered attacks. She is slowed when moving away from you.
Use Stand United to shield a teammate Fiora is diving, or to join a fight elsewhere once you reach level 6.
Dash with Shadow Dash onto Gangplank when he is out of position; the taunt forces him to attack you and breaks his keg setup.
Watch for Remove Scurvy; he can cleanse your taunt, so dash when it is on cooldown.
Stay away from Powder Keg blasts; they slow you and hit hard, so do not walk next to kegs.
Recall Twilight Assault through Gangplank to slow him and power up your next attacks, then fight him up close.
Use Stand United to join fights when Gangplank's Cannon Barrage lands on an ally; the shield helps them survive.

comboRefs.note: Shadow Dash taunts Gangplank, and Twilight Assault then slows him so you can hit him with empowered attacks.

tips.text: Aim Shadow Dash at Garen to taunt him, then fight while he can't walk away from you freely.
Hit Garen with Twilight Assault on the way back so he's slowed. Then trade with your empowered attacks.
Garen heals when left alone, so keep hitting him with Twilight Assault and don't let him reset.
Respect Garen's Decisive Strike; its silence stops your abilities. Stay back until he has used it.
Back away from Garen when your health gets low; Demacian Justice can finish you.
Dash into Jayce with Shadow Dash when he comes in close; he is taunted and has to attack you. Follow with Twilight Assault's empowered attacks.
Send the Spirit Blade through Jayce with Twilight Assault so he is slowed and your next attacks hit harder and faster.
Jayce's cannon stance pokes from far away. Trade only when Jayce is close, and stay out of his range when you cannot reach him.
Place Spirit's Refuge where Jayce's melee attacks will land. It blocks his basic attacks, and also his Thundering Blow and Shock Blast damage.
Watch your Energy. Hitting Jayce with Twilight Assault or Shadow Dash gives some back, so use them to trade and keep going.
Dodge K'Sante's stun-pull from Ntofo Strikes by watching for his second hit; if he lands one, expect the next to pull and stun you.
Use Shadow Dash to taunt K'Sante when he commits to a trade, then hit him with your empowered attacks from Twilight Assault.
Send Twilight Assault back through K'Sante so it hits him; you get the stronger empowered attacks and slow him.
Place Spirit's Refuge where K'Sante will attack. It blocks his basic attacks and the empowered hit from his passive.
Be careful when K'Sante goes All Out; he is much squishier then, so stay close and burst him instead of running.
Dodge Malphite's Seismic Shard if you can, or stay near minions. It is a targeted spell, so you cannot dodge it; do not walk up while it is ready.
Hit Malphite with Twilight Assault when his Granite Shield is down, then follow with your empowered attacks.
Use Shadow Dash to taunt Malphite only when his Ground Slam is on cooldown, so you can fight without losing Attack Speed.
Use Stand United to join or save your allies against Malphite's Unstoppable Force; its shield absorbs some of the damage.
Use Shadow Dash on Mordekaiser to taunt him, then attack. Only do it when his Obliterate is on cooldown.
Stay away from Mordekaiser once Darkness Rise is active; its aura hurts everyone near him. Back off and wait for it to run out.
Twilight Assault slows Mordekaiser if the Spirit Blade hits him on its way back. Use it to keep him from chasing you.
Wait out the Indestructible shield before you attack him again. Hitting a fresh shield wastes your damage.
Stay out of a straight line from Mordekaiser so Death's Grasp misses you. If it pulls you in, an Obliterate often follows.
Once Mordekaiser reaches level 6, stand away from him unless you have to fight. Realm of Death cuts you off from your allies, and Stand United can't help.
Dodge Electro Harpoon where you can. Getting hit twice slows you more and cuts your Magic Resist.
Dash in with Shadow Dash when Rumble overheats. He can't cast then, so the taunt is hard for him to escape.
Use Twilight Assault to hit Rumble; it slows him and empowers your next attacks. Then trade with those attacks.
Step out of The Equalizer's fire quickly; staying in it hurts a lot. Walking toward Rumble out of the fire works better than running with it.
Use Spirit's Refuge on yourself to block Rumble's basic attacks while he is overheating.
Look to teleport with Stand United to help allies in other lanes when your lane is pushed in. Rumble's damage is hard to trade with early.

comboRefs.note: Dash into Twilight Assault lets Shen taunt and pull Rumble, slowing him so Shen's attacks land.

tips.text: Don't stand still while Sion charges Decimating Smash; walk out of the line, since a full charge stuns for a long time.
Use Twilight Assault on Sion when you trade; the slow helps you move away when he starts to charge.
Taunt Sion with Shadow Dash when he commits to a charge; it pulls him off his target.
Hold back from Sion's Roar of the Slayer, because it slows you and he often follows it with a stun.
Don't chase Sion into a kill; when he dies he comes back with Glory in Death and hits hard. Back off and wait it out.

comboRefs.note: Dash taunts Sion, then Twilight Assault slows him and empowers your attacks for a clean trade.

tips.text: Hit Teemo with Twilight Assault before you walk in. You get stronger attacks and he is slowed when he backs away.
Use Shadow Dash to taunt Teemo when he is close, then attack him. He can't run while taunted.
Use Spirit's Refuge to block Teemo's attacks while you trade. His Toxic Shot hits are basic attacks.
Don't walk into unwarded brush; Teemo can hide there and Noxious Trap mushrooms are stealthed. Check bushes before you step in.

comboRefs.note: Dash taunts Teemo, and Twilight Assault slows him so Shen can hit him right after landing.

tips.text: Land Shadow Dash on Vayne to taunt her, then fight right away. She is fragile and cannot kite you while she is taunted.
Don't let Vayne pin you against a wall. Condemn stuns and hurts a lot when you hit terrain, so stay away from walls.
Use Twilight Assault to recall your blade through Vayne; she is slowed when moving away, and your next attacks have longer reach.
Put Spirit's Refuge down where you will fight; it blocks Vayne's attacks, including her Silver Bolts hits.
Look for Vayne after Tumble is used up. Shadow Dash in then, since she has less room to dodge away.

comboRefs.note: Dash taunts Vayne, then Twilight Assault slows her and empowers attacks so Shen can trade.

tips.text: Aim Shadow Dash at Yone when he walks up to trade; if he is taunted you get a free round of attacks on him.
Send Twilight Assault through Yone and then hit him with your empowered attacks. It slows him if he tries to walk away.
Place Spirit's Refuge when Yone commits to a trade, since it blocks his basic attacks and the damage from his Mortal Steel.
Once you reach level 6, use Stand United to shield an ally in trouble. You teleport to them after the channel.

comboRefs.note: Dashing E into Q taunts-trade and slows Yone, so you can land basic attacks on him right away.

tips.text: Walk over Bard's Caretaker's Shrine when you can; an enemy champion stepping on it destroys it, so his allies lose the heal.
Stay out of a straight line with another unit when Bard aims Cosmic Binding. Hit by two targets or a wall, you get stunned.
Use Shadow Dash to make Bard attack you when he steps up, then follow with Twilight Assault to hit him again and slow his retreat.
Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks, including Bard's meep-empowered ones. Use it when you and your carry get poked.
You can follow Bard through his Magical Journey portal if it is safe. Be careful, because he can punish you on the other side.
Bard's Tempered Fate freezes everything it hits, so don't dash in on a frozen carry. Wait for it to end before you fight.

comboRefs.note: Dashing into Twilight Assault slows Bard, who has no listed dash to escape the taunt follow-up.

tips.text: Aim Shadow Dash at Braum or his partner when Unbreakable is down; it taunts them so your team can hit them.
Do not throw Twilight Assault into Braum's raised shield; wait until Unbreakable ends.
Step out of range after Braum's first Concussive Blows hit; if allies hit you too, you get stunned.
Use Spirit's Refuge on your ally when Braum and his partner go for an all-in; it blocks their basic attacks, which also stops Concussive Blows stacks.
At level 6, use Stand United on a carry caught by Glacial Fissure or another all-in. Shen arrives between them and the nearest enemy.

comboRefs.note: Taunting Braum then pulling Twilight Assault through him slows him and sets up your empowered attacks.

tips.text: Dodge Inner Flame; it stops at the first enemy it hits and slows. Stand behind minions to absorb it.
Move away from Focused Resolve's tether so you aren't rooted, then engage.
Step out of the flame circle that Mantra leaves behind. It explodes for heavy damage if you stay in it.
Use Shadow Dash to taunt Karma when she is in range. Follow with Twilight Assault for your empowered attacks.
Use Spirit's Refuge when Karma's team wants to trade attacks, since it blocks basic attacks on you and your allies.

comboRefs.note: Flash adds taunt reach to catch Karma when she stays just out of Shadow Dash range.
Taunting Karma and throwing Twilight Assault back slows her and gets empowered attacks.

tips.text: Dodge Leona's Zenith Blade; once it hits, she dashes in and roots you, so stay back when it is ready.
Use Shadow Dash on Leona only after she spends her stun; the taunt then gives your carry time to hit her.
Place Spirit's Refuge on your ADC when Leona engages; it blocks basic attacks, including her stunning Shield of Daybreak attack.
Leave the Solar Flare center once it is cast, so you are only slowed instead of stunned.

comboRefs.note: Slowing a taunted Leona with Twilight Assault helps against her melee all-in kit.

tips.text: Walk up and hit with Shadow Dash only when Whimsy is used or on cooldown; if Lulu polymorphs you mid-dash, you lose the whole trade.
Stay behind minions so Pix's bolts from Pix, Faerie Companion hit the minions instead of you.
Sidestep Glitterlance; it slows you and its two bolts can cross, so give it room instead of walking in a straight line.
Use Spirit's Refuge on your ally when Lulu and her partner attack, since it blocks their basic attacks.
Pull the Spirit Blade back with Twilight Assault through the enemy to slow them and get empowered attacks for a quick trade.
Watch for Wild Growth on her carry; it knocks up enemies nearby, so keep your distance when they are about to engage.

comboRefs.note: Flash adds taunt reach to catch Lulu when she kites out of Shadow Dash range with her slows.

tips.text: Walk up and use Shadow Dash on Lux when her Light Binding is on cooldown; she has little to stop you and gets taunted into your attacks.
Stay behind your minions or off her line, since Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits and sets up her follow-up.
Hit Lux with Twilight Assault to slow her as she backs away, then follow with an empowered attack.
Drop Spirit's Refuge on your ally when Lux pokes with basic attacks; it blocks attacks and damage from abilities that use basic damage.
Move to the side when Final Spark's red line appears, and use Stand United to save a far-away ally from a burst.

comboRefs.note: Flash adds taunt reach to catch Lux, who is easy to reach for a taunt only if she stays just out of range.
Taunting Lux then throwing Twilight Assault slows her and sets up empowered attacks on a fragile target.

tips.text: Dash at Milio with Shadow Dash when he is away from his ally; he is taunted and cannot kick or hug until it ends.
Sidestep Ultra Mega Fire Kick; if it hits you are stunned and knocked back, so stay out of its line or behind a minion.
Recall Twilight Assault through Milio so he is slowed and your next attacks hit harder.
Use Spirit's Refuge to block attacks from his ally when you both trade, as the shield zone stops basic attacks.

comboRefs.note: Flash adds taunt reach, which helps catch Milio when he stays just outside Shadow Dash range.

tips.text: Walk up and use Shadow Dash on Nami when her Aqua Prison is on cooldown; she has little to stop you and you taunt her into your attacks.
Stay out of Aqua Prison's landing spot; it takes a moment to land, so keep moving sideways and never walk in a straight line toward Nami.
Hit Nami with Twilight Assault on the way back to Shen, then punch her with the empowered attacks while she is slowed.
Use Spirit's Refuge when you and your carry are being hit by basic attacks; it blocks them, though not turret shots.
Don't fight an enemy carrying Tidecaller's Blessing; step back and let it run out before you trade.
Watch for Tidal Wave from far away and step out of its path; it moves slowly.

comboRefs.note: Flash adds taunt reach to catch Nami, who must otherwise stay out of range to avoid being engaged.

tips.text: Stay out of Dredge Line range and keep minions between you and Nautilus; the anchor stops on the first enemy it hits.
Cast Spirit's Refuge on your ally when Nautilus walks up to attack; it blocks his basic attacks, including the Staggering Blow root.
Use Twilight Assault to poke when the blade can pass through him, then hit him with the empowered attacks.
Taunt Nautilus with Shadow Dash when he commits to a pull and misses, then trade while his Dredge Line is on cooldown.
Once you reach level 6, use Stand United on an ally Nautilus has pulled in; the shield helps them survive the stun.

comboRefs.note: Taunting Nautilus then throwing Twilight Assault back slows him and sets up Shen's empowered attack.

tips.text: Aim Shadow Dash at Pantheon when he is out of position. The taunt makes him hit you instead of your carry.
Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the front. Dash behind Pantheon or wait out the channel.
Keep your health up. Pantheon's thrown Comet Spear hits much harder on low-health targets.
Use Spirit's Refuge on your ally when Pantheon leaps in. It blocks basic attacks, including his triple-strike attack after Shield Vault.
Grand Starfall gives long warning. Move out of the area, or use Stand United to join and protect a threatened ally.

comboRefs.note: Throwing Twilight Assault back through the taunted Pantheon slows him as he tries to leave.

tips.text: Dodge Pyke's Bone Skewer pull, then Shadow Dash onto him right after it misses so he can't follow up.
Cast Spirit's Refuge on your carry when Pyke commits; it blocks his basic attacks and the abilities that count as basic damage.
Taunt Pyke with Shadow Dash when he walks up to engage, so your carry gets time to hit him.
When sharks circle under your feet, Pyke is hiding nearby. Stay back from low-health allies and keep Shadow Dash ready.
Use Stand United on a low-health ally Pyke is chasing; the shield grows as they lose health, and you arrive between them and the enemy.
Dodge nothing, just walk up: Shadow Dash taunts Senna, so use it when she is close and hit her while she can't walk away.
Send Twilight Assault through Senna to slow her, then hit her with your empowered attacks.
Drop Spirit's Refuge on your ADC when Senna pokes with basic attacks; it blocks basic attacks aimed at allied champions in the zone.
Stay out of Senna's line when Last Embrace is ready; her root is how she catches you for her team.

comboRefs.note: Taunting Senna and slowing her with Twilight Assault lets Shen land empowered attacks on her.

tips.text: Dash into Seraphine with Shadow Dash to taunt her, then hit her with your empowered attacks while she can't cast.
Stay out of a straight line from Seraphine; Beat Drop slows you and roots you if you are already slowed.
Use Twilight Assault to pull your Spirit Blade back through her; it slows her and powers up your next attacks.
Place Spirit's Refuge over your ADC when Seraphine's team goes for basic attacks; it blocks them.
Keep your distance from Encore when your team is bunched up; the charm can stretch across many champions.
Dash onto Sona with Shadow Dash when she stands close; the taunt forces her to attack you instead of casting freely.
Throw Twilight Assault through Sona on its way back to slow her and power up your next attacks.
Use Spirit's Refuge when Sona's Hymn of Valor and auto attacks come in; it blocks enemy basic attacks on you and your ally.
Once you hit level 6, watch Sona's Crescendo and use Stand United to shield an ally and teleport in, or save them.

comboRefs.note: Dashing into a Spirit Blade slows a taunted Sona, who is otherwise hard to pin down.

tips.text: Dodge Death Sentence by watching Thresh's cast start; if it lands you are stunned and pulled, so stay out of a straight line with him.
Use Shadow Dash on Thresh when he misses Death Sentence; the taunt forces him to attack you while your team hits him.
Twilight Assault passes through enemies, so throw it so it hits Thresh on the way back. He is slowed and your next attacks hit harder.
Spirit's Refuge blocks Thresh's basic attacks on you and your ally, so use it when he walks up to hit with his empowered attack.
Take Thresh's souls as a cue: he is weaker before he collects them, so trade when he steps away to grab one.

comboRefs.note: Flash adds taunt reach to catch a Thresh who stays just outside Shadow Dash range.
